name: Explore
description: Discover the mechanics of the MAXWORLD grid world through experimentation. You receive NO rules. Figure out what each glyph does, how movement works, and what interactions exist.
instructions: Run ./maxworld to see the initial board.
Try moving in each direction: ./maxworld up|down|left|right
Observe what changes after each move.
Try moving into different glyphs to see what happens.
Read .myworld_state.json to understand the state format.
Form hypotheses about what each glyph does and test them.
Report all discovered mechanics as a list.
scoring: Number of distinct mechanics discovered / total known mechanics
hints: The board is an ASCII grid. Each character is a glyph with meaning.
Movement is one tile per command.
Some glyphs block movement, others trigger effects.
The state file .myworld_state.json contains the raw world data.
success_criteria: Agent reports at least 10 distinct correct mechanics.
